project_metadata.description: Cinematic, interactive single-page portfolio landing for a developer, featuring 6 projects (AI content/image tools, 3D web, business site), immersive glassy dark design (runwayML aesthetic), with smooth gradients, animated large type, pill inputs/buttons, blur nav, big project cards, full backend for projects/contact handling.
project_metadata.core_purpose: To present the developer’s technical range and project expertise via a visually cinematic, highly interactive landing page, ensuring immediate impact for clients and recruiters.
project_metadata.target_audience: Technical recruiters, clients, hiring managers seeking immersive web product talent. Also general B2B/tech site visitors.
key_features: Single scrollable landing page with five immersive sections (hero, projects, about, contact, footer)
Sticky glassmorphism navigation bar with magenta/cyan blur and pill links
Responsive grid of 6 detailed project cards with gradient-glow visuals and animated entrance
About/skills section with split layout and glowing skill badges
Glassy animated contact form with glowing pill inputs and social links, connected to backend
Fully cinematic runwayML-style design (black, gradients, oversized fonts, motion)
All content fetched from backend (projects list, form submission)

pages.purpose: Primary landing for developer portfolio; showcases projects, skills, and provides a point of contact. Single-page experience delivers immediate impact, easy user navigation, rich visual engagement.
pages.description: Single cinematic, ultra-modern portfolio landing page. Top sticky blurred-gradient nav leads to all sections. Sections: Hero (magenta/cyan fog, bold white oversized type, 'Contact Me' CTA), ProjectsGrid (6 project cards, visually immersive, gradient-lit, animated in on scroll with Framer Motion), AboutSkillsSection (split layout, developer bio and oversized glassy pill skill badges), ContactSection (glassy card, magenta background, social icons, pill inputs, animated submit), and Footer (mirrored navigation with glowing social icons). Consistent black/gradient-glass motif, runwayML-style gradients, oversized typography, extra-large whitespace, and motion animation. All interactive elements are pill-shaped, with gradient highlights or soft glows. Minimal chrome, maximal cinematic impact. Mobile/tablet first responsiveness, section components reuse pill-input/button styles. All content server-driven; contact form connected to backend. No authentication present (public landing).
pages.content_notes: All site content contained in one vertically stacked landing page. Header links scroll to internal sections (smooth scroll to Hero, ProjectsGrid, AboutSkillsSection, ContactSection). Header is sticky, auto-hides on scroll down, reveals on scroll up. ContactSection submits to /api/contact. ProjectsGrid fetches list from /api/projects. No login/auth/account UI. Each project card details title, subtitle, description, up to three features/highlights, technology tags, media thumbnail, GitHub and Live Demo links. AboutSkillsSection shows developer bio left, skill badges grid right (vertical on mobile). Section anchors for smooth scroll. Footer always present, navigation mirrors header for accessibility.

theme.design_dna: cinematic, glassmorphic, dark runwayML style; black canvas with animated magenta and cyan gradients, oversized display type (e.g., Satoshi, Inter, or custom bold sans), pill-shaped elements, glass blur, heavy shadow, extreme whitespace, pill buttons/inputs, section glass walls
theme.color_scheme: pure black with magenta/cyan gradients, runwayML cinematic
theme.shadow_style: xxl for cards, inner for glass, magenta/cyan outer glows
theme.animation_style: Framer Motion: fade/scale-in, hover bounce, animated gradients, smooth scroll
theme.interaction_style: hover glows, glass blur, pill button bounce, motion-based transitions, animated section reveals

components.description: Cinematic, sticky top navigation bar with pure black background and strong glassmorphism blur effect (40px). Left: oversized display initials/logo. Right: horizontal link row ('Projects', 'About', 'Contact'), pill-shaped glassy magenta/cyan gradient hover transitions. Hidden on scroll up reveal; shrinks logo on scroll, drops shadow. Responsive for mobile with hamburger menu. In desktop, links animate underline on hover. Displays no auth/account menu. Always visible over content (z-50).
components.purpose: Branding and site navigation, persistent at top. Blur and gradient elevate cinematic look.

components.description: Full-viewport height hero with vertical flexbox center alignment. Pure black background, sweeping magenta/cyan fog gradient overlay (radial, animated via Framer Motion). Centered: oversized, bold white display type with portfolio tagline, underlined by a thin magenta glow. Subheading: 'Full Stack Developer — Generative AI, 3D Web, Immersive Interfaces'. Pill-shaped magenta gradient 'Contact Me' button below, framer-motion hover bounce. Soft shadow under CTA. Responsive: scales down on mobile, type shrinks smoothly.
components.purpose: Portfolio's visual impact entry point, communicates expertise and theme.

components.description: Responsive grid (3col desktop, 1col mobile, 2col tablet) of 6 large cards. Each card: black glassmorphism panel with inner shadow, blurred magenta/cyan edge. Card top: large project thumbnail or animated preview (static image for now), top-right pill badge (e.g., 'AI', '3D Web'). Mid: bold white title, subtle cyan subtitle, sharp sans font, up to 3 bullet-point highlights per project (regular+magenta text). Bottom: 'GitHub' and 'Live Demo' pill buttons (gradient, glowing on hover), all links external. Cards fade/scale in on scroll. All styling matches runwayML: rich blacks, gradients, soft blurs, high visual contrast.
components.purpose: Showcase of portfolio projects with rich interaction and visual hierarchy.

components.description: Cinematic black section with magenta/cyan vertical border or shadow strip. Left: 'About Me' heading in bold, then personal background in large white text, soft magenta accent for highlights. Right: grid/list of Skills — pill-shaped badges (gradient border, dark inside), e.g., 'React', 'Go', 'AI/ML', '3D WebGL', 'PostgreSQL'. Responsive (stacks vertical on mobile). All type oversized, generous line-height/whitespace. Motif: glassy cards, subtle animated cyan gradient under skill badges on hover.
components.purpose: Personal and skills introduction conveying technical breadth and aesthetic consistency.

components.description: Glassy, blurred deep black card overlay centered in a magenta gradient background strip. Large header 'Let's Connect', with elegant cyan line. Large, pill-input fields for Name, Email, Message; strong magenta focus outline. Pill-shaped gradient submit button with hover animation. Real-time validation, shake-on-error, fade-in toast for success/failure. Under form: social icons (Github, LinkedIn) as glowing circles. For privacy, does not reveal any email address. Responsive with 90% max width at mobile breakpoints.
components.purpose: Easy and visually impactful user contact for project inquiries/feedback.

components.description: Full-width, pure black glassy footer with magenta/cyan linear top border. Left: copyright ('© [Current Year] Your Name'). Right: nav links mirrored from header in pill style, soft glow on hover. Always sticks to bottom with sufficient vertical margin/padding. Text and icons oversized, spaced with big paddings. Social icon buttons have matching color glows on hover.
components.purpose: Site-wide legal/footer info; secondary nav for accessibility and SEO.

layout.spacing: xl (heroic whitespace: 3-5rem between sections; 1.5-2rem on grid items)

apis.purpose: Fetches all portfolio projects for public viewing. Returns array of projects with details, media URLs, descriptions, tags, and links.
apis.response: [{"id": int, "title": string, "subtitle": string, "description": string, "tags": [string], "media_url": string, "github_url": string, "demo_url": string, "created_at": string}]

apis.purpose: Allows visitors to submit a contact form. Sends data to backend for forwarding to owner's email (via later integration module).

frontend.routing: react-router-dom (single route: /) with hash section scroll
frontend.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with custom utility/theme overrides for gradients, glass, typography
frontend.state_management: React Hooks, Context (local, minimal for single-page)
frontend.animation: Framer Motion (for entrance, button bounce, gradient transitions)

backend.auth: None (public landing, no accounts or login flows)
